info.title: dataverse-fluent
info.description: The dataverse-fluent command: checks a project's Dataverse.Fluent models against an environment's metadata, and fixes the mechanical mistakes (lookup navigation properties and target entity sets, polymorphic targets, read-only markers) in the source.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Checks Dataverse.Fluent models against a Dataverse environment's metadata, and fixes the mechanical mistakes.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Checks the models, then applies the fixes to the source and checks again.

options.name: --url
options.description: The environment URL, e.g. https://yourorg.crm.dynamics.com. Default: the DATAVERSE_URL environment variable.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Sign in with a browser instead of DefaultAzureCredential (az login, Visual Studio, or AZURE_* variables).

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant to sign in to.

options.name: --api-version
options.description: The Web API version. [default: v9.2]

options.name: --type
options.description: Check only this model (full or simple name). Repeat for several.

options.name: --resolver
options.description: The full name of an IDataverseNameResolver in the project to register before checking, for models mapped by a resolver.

options.name: --ignore
options.description: Leave out findings with this code, e.g. DVS015. Repeat for several.

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description: Exit with code 1 when a warning is found, not only an error.

options.name: --no-select-check
options.description: Skip the live $select check (one retrieve of a random ID per model).

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration. [default: Debug]

options.name: --framework
options.description: The target framework of a multi-targeted project. Default: its first.

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Use the existing build output.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the stack trace of an unexpected error.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the changes as a diff and write nothing.

options.name: --force
options.description: Write a file even when the check of its planned edit fails. Without it, that file is held back and its diff is printed.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: The .csproj, or a directory holding one. [default: .]

commands.name: scaffold
commands.description: Fills in a project's models from the environment: mapping attributes, read-only markers and property types.

options.name: --url
options.description: The environment URL, e.g. https://yourorg.crm.dynamics.com. Default: the DATAVERSE_URL environment variable.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Sign in with a browser instead of DefaultAzureCredential (az login, Visual Studio, or AZURE_* variables).

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant to sign in to.

options.name: --api-version
options.description: The Web API version. [default: v9.2]

options.name: --type
options.description: Fill in only this model (full or simple name). Repeat for several.

options.name: --table
options.description: Write a new model for this table (its logical name), with --columns and --output, instead of filling in a project's models.

options.name: --columns
options.description: With --table: the logical names of the columns the model gets, separated by commas.

options.name: --output
options.description: With --table: the file to write.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: With --table: the namespace of the new model. Default: none.

options.name: --class
options.description: With --table: the class name. Default: from the table's schema name.

options.name: --enums
options.description: Write an enum for each choice column, in place of int.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Leave this property alone, e.g. Incident.Summary: for one that is not a column. Repeat for several.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration the project is read with. [default: Debug]

options.name: --framework
options.description: The target framework of a multi-targeted project. Default: its first.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the changes and write nothing.

options.name: --force
options.description: Write a file even when the check of its planned edit fails. Without it, that file is held back and its diff is printed.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the stack trace of an unexpected error.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: The .csproj, or a directory holding one, whose models to fill in. Not used with --table. [default: .]
